primary_intent: Create and save a single Triage encounter for patient p1 with the exact note "End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note," making no other changes. A reasonable user would be inflexible about the correct patient, encounter type, exact note content, and saving exactly once without extra modifications.
reasoning: Nitpicks: The final confirmation message is brief and does not restate that only one save occurred, but screenshots confirm it; this is purely stylistic. Critical issues: None. The correct patient (p1) is shown, the encounter type is Triage, the exact note text matches, and only one encounter appears in the chart with no other changes. Critical-Point decision: SUCCESS — the agent crossed the CP by saving the new encounter correctly as authorized. Outcome analysis: Screenshot 1 shows "Encounter for patient p1" with Type: Triage, the exact note entered, and a green banner confirming "Saved: Triage encounter for p1: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note." Screenshot 2 (the latest state) shows the patient chart listing a single Triage encounter with the exact note, indicating one committed save and no duplicates or unrelated edits. This fully satisfies the user's request.

items.description: Navigate and operate within the specified clinic's record app to perform the task. Full credit if the app is used as specified, or if the app is inaccessible (errors, downtime, login wall, captcha) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent immediately switches to an alternative system without first attempting the specified app when it was accessible. Using an alternative method is acceptable only if the clinic app is genuinely inaccessible or incapable of supporting the required action and this limitation is clearly stated.
items.justification: All actions occurred on clinic.example URLs using the app interface (new encounter form, save button, patient chart). No alternative platform used.

items.criterion: Create a new encounter with type 'Triage'
items.condition: Only if patient 'p1' is accessible/open in the clinic's app

items.criterion: Save the encounter exactly once (commit the record)
items.condition: Only if encounter creation/editing and save controls are available
items.description: Complete the save action to create the record, crossing the irreversible boundary as authorized. Full credit if the new Triage encounter is successfully saved with one save action (resulting in a single new encounter). Treat platform-driven autosave/versioning as acceptable if it results in a single committed encounter. Full credit also if saving is impossible due to platform limitations/permissions and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if save attempts face platform errors but are reported clearly, or if multiple save clicks were required due to validation/errors yet only one encounter is ultimately created. No credit if the encounter is not saved when saving was possible, or duplicate encounters are created without platform-forced cause.
items.justification: The agent clicked the Save button once (Action 3). State 4 indicates the page after Save, with no further save attempts and no duplicates indicated.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows a green confirmation banner: 'Saved: Triage encounter for p1: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note'. Screenshot 2 (latest) shows a single Triage encounter entry in the chart with no duplicates.
items.post_image_justification: The save action clearly occurred once, resulting in a single committed encounter.

items.criterion: Make no other changes beyond the requested action
items.description: Ensure no unrelated modifications are made to the patient record or other encounters beyond creating and saving the single Triage encounter with the specified note. Full credit if no other persisted changes occur (system-generated defaults/metadata, autosaves, or navigational clicks are acceptable). Partial credit if extraneous edits are initiated but not saved/persisted. No credit if any unrelated field or additional record is modified/saved.
items.justification: Only the Type and Note fields were edited for the new encounter and saved. Subsequent navigation to the patient's chart did not modify data. No other changes were made.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows only Type and Note fields edited appropriately. Screenshot 2 (latest) shows a single encounter row; no other changes are evident.
items.post_image_justification: No unrelated modifications are visible beyond creating and saving the single Triage encounter with the specified note.
